verdict.rationale: Vercel's Marketplace lists native, first-party integrations (Neon Postgres, Pinecone, Shopify, Slack, Jira/Linear, etc.) that plug into a project with managed credentials, reducing manual SDK wiring, and Vercel documents environment/variable management across environments. However, a concrete community report states that connecting to a database with more than a password requires 'contact sales' for enterprise, indicating the native-binding security experience is limited for standard tiers, and there's no first-party technical deep-dive on how the binding/credential injection mechanism works beyond marketplace listings. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the binding mechanism itself, independent hands-on confirmation of minimal-boilerplate setup, and resolution of the enterprise-gating friction noted in community feedback.
